sloka: स शिष्यावब्रवीद्धृष्टौ युवां गत्वा समाहितौ ।कृत्स्नं रामायणं काव्यं गायेथां परया मुदा ।। ७.९३.५ ॥
transliteration: sa śiṣyāvabravīddhṛṣṭau yuvāṁ gatvā samāhitau ।kṛtsnaṁ rāmāyaṇaṁ kāvyaṁ gāyethāṁ parayā mudā ।। 7.93.5 ॥

translations.english: Valmiki, delighted, instructed his two disciples to go and sing the entire epic poem of Ramayana with utmost concentration and joy.
